name: app-check-client-initialize-twice-unset-auto-refresh
description: initializeAppCheck called a second time on the same app with the same provider instance, where one of the two calls omits isTokenAutoRefreshEnabled: omitted then false, false then omitted, and omitted both times.

unsetThenFalse.name: FirebaseError
unsetThenFalse.message: AppCheck: You have already called initializeAppCheck() for FirebaseApp twice-unset-false with different options. To avoid this error, call initializeAppCheck() with the same options as when it was originally called. This will return the already initialized instance. (appCheck/already-initialized).

falseThenUnset.name: FirebaseError
falseThenUnset.message: AppCheck: You have already called initializeAppCheck() for FirebaseApp twice-false-unset with different options. To avoid this error, call initializeAppCheck() with the same options as when it was originally called. This will return the already initialized instance. (appCheck/already-initialized).
